gtin.description: The GTIN of this level (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, valid mod-10 check digit; indicator digit 9 is rejected). Stored as 14 digits.

childGtin.description: The GTIN of the child level, an ACTIVE lower level of this product. Required for every level but EACH, which has none.

qtyOfChild.description: How many child packs make one of this level. Required for every level but EACH, which has none.

unitsPerPack.description: Optional direct factor to eaches. Omitted means `qtyOfChild` times the child's factor (1 for EACH); a given value must equal that.

dims.description: Declared dimensions and weight of ONE pack of the level.
dims.title: PackDimensionsInput

isOrderable.description: Whether this level can be ordered from the supplier. Omitted means false.

isDespatchUnit.description: Whether this level ships as a unit. Omitted means false.
